Modeled revenue is up about $434,700 per day, roughly 4% over baseline. The model doesn't split this into causes, so this is my reading of the pattern.

- **More people nearby:** The plan doubles residential density on 13 blocks, adding about 12,350 residents. Total people in the model rise by about 11,360.
- **More foot traffic:** Walking minutes rise by about 187,000 and visits by about 17,700. Pedestrianizing 2nd and Minna Streets lifts foot traffic there, and 6th Street gains too.
- **Where it lands:** Mostly shops. American Giant gains about $19,300 per day, Hook & Scissor about $17,000, and Yoshida Picture Framing about $16,100.
